g.text: Put the sharp vertex at the fifth cut

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405766

g.text: Two new proved families whose four-cut sources have curvature below 180°.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405766

g.text: Blue quadrilaterals stay whole. Red: source cuts. Gold: the fifth cut. Each net preserves its shape.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405766

g.text: The drawings illustrate exact examples; the geometric inequalities prove the families.
